This led to errors in the determination of which members of Fubo's management team joined during its IPO year. While David Gandler was indeed a co-founder of FuboTV (meaning he joined the company earlier than 2020), the agent misinterpreted the search results and associated his joining year with April 2020. Similarly, the claim that John Janedis joined in March 2020 was made without confirming this date via authoritative sources. This mistake impacted the final solution, as it led to an incorrect conclusion that both individuals joined during the IPO year. 

The error stems from over-reliance on potentially incomplete or misinterpreted search result summaries, as well as inadequate focus on sourcing information specifically from primary or authoritative references.
